items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: And I said, that old Fred Kessler here, and he's a little old man.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. But that's before my time. Yeah.
He said, he was one of those. And I said, that old Fred Kessler here, and he's a little old man. And how old were you then? Good boy. Good boy.
